metadata.description: RevCognition finds your ideal clients and writes each one a unique message. You write nothing. You pay no agency. And you don't have to find the time.

problem.heading: What are you doing right now?
problem.intro: Every option has a real cost. It's just that with one of them, that cost shows up on the invoice.

items.label: Your contact network
items.description: You prospect when you have time, which is almost never. The system stops the moment you do.

items.label: A lead-gen agency
items.description: You get reports, not meetings. The messages are generic even when you're told they're personalized. You never see what's sent in your name.

items.label: A generic tool
items.description: You need to be technical to use it, or accept that the messages carry no context about your business or your prospect's.

contrast.description: The system finds prospects that match your profile, writes a unique message for each one, and sends it. You see every message before it goes out. No technical setup, no middlemen.

howItWorks.heading: Three steps. Then the system works on its own.

steps.title: Tell us who you are
steps.description: We analyze your website and automatically generate positioning proposals: what problem you solve, your tone, your services, and your ideal customer profile. You pick the strategy that fits you best.

steps.title: The system identifies your prospects
steps.description: RevCognition finds companies that match your profile, enriches them with real signals (sector, size, activity, intent signals), and builds a qualified list.

steps.title: Every prospect gets a message written for them
steps.description: An LLM combines your profile, our bank of high-performing sales messages, and the prospect's data to write a unique message. You approve the daily sends or let them go out on their own.

mensaje.title: Message
mensaje.body: I saw that Bufete Serrano is taking part in the ENISA call. At similar firms we've helped structure the proposal and...

featuresGrid.heading: All the mechanical work of prospecting, done.
featuresGrid.intro: You keep the judgment calls; the system puts in the hours. Here's what it takes care of, day after day.

howEncuentra.intro: What if your industry is niche, or your target area is small? The search doesn't rely on a single list: for just one customer profile there can be more than 400,000 candidate companies spread across several databases, and the system keeps checking them non-stop to keep only the ones that fit.

steps.title: Reads your website
steps.description: Understands what problem you solve and what type of customer you serve, from your own website.

steps.title: Builds your ideal customer profile
steps.description: Turns that into an ideal customer profile: industry, location, and company size.

steps.title: Searches continuously across partner databases
steps.description: Matches that profile non-stop against several company databases and scores each one on how well it fits.

steps.title: Verifies emails and detects buying signals
steps.description: Finds the right contact at each company, verifies their email before writing, and checks for recent signals, like a new hire.

features.title: You approve what goes out
features.description: Five minutes a day to review the prepared emails. Nothing goes out without your sign-off, and you can turn off approval once you trust the system.

features.title: Your own domain, warmed up patiently
features.description: A dedicated sending domain that ramps up its volume gradually over the first few weeks, to land in the inbox instead of spam.

features.title: A message written for each prospect
features.description: Every email is written from scratch with the real context of your business and the recipient. A sequence of up to four messages, not a filled-in template.

features.title: Replies sort themselves
features.description: Interested, not interested, hostile, or out of office: every reply is read and sorted on its own. Interested ones are prioritized, and we notify you by email and Telegram.

features.title: Six senders with their own signature
features.description: Your emails go out spread across six mailboxes, each with its real name and title, to protect the domain's reputation.

features.title: From a reply to a meeting
features.description: When someone replies with interest, the sequence pauses and we notify you instantly by email and Telegram. Your Cal.com link travels in every email, so they can also book directly from there.

features.title: Bring your own contacts
features.description: Already have a list? Upload it as CSV and it enters the same personalization and sending machinery as automatic search.

features.title: You pay per prospect worked
features.description: Not per seat or subscription. One credit for each new prospect written to; follow-ups in that sequence don't cost extra credit.

cases.problem: A database of perfect signals, emails nobody answers
cases.problemDetail: Every rejected trademark filing is a company with a real legal urgency. They have the database. But the emails their agency sends are generic, without mentioning the specific rejection or the concrete risk. Result: almost zero replies, despite having the clearest intent signal there is.
cases.solution: RevCognition takes that case base as context, writes a message that mentions each company's specific rejection, and leaves it ready for your five-minute daily review.

cases.problem: You prospect through your personal network. When you're busy, everything stops
cases.problemDetail: One person handles everything. They know there's a market, they know they should prospect more. But prospecting always gets pushed to whenever there's time, which never comes. There's no system, just sporadic calls to contacts they already know.
cases.solution: RevCognition identifies companies in the sector that match the ideal customer profile, enriches them, and writes them contextualized messages. The system keeps running even while the founder is with a client.

pricing.heading: From €1 per prospect. The bigger the pack, the cheaper per email.
pricing.intro: You don't pay for seats or tools. You pay per prospect worked: 1 credit is spent on the first email to a new prospect, and the follow-ups in that same sequence don't cost extra. If they reply first, the system stops. If not, it closes gracefully.
pricing.perProspectIncludes: Every prospect includes: identification, enrichment with real signals, and a full sequence (opener, follow-up, new angle, close).
pricing.noCommitment: No commitment, no subscription. Credits never expire.
